run_PPO_training: run PPO reinforcement learning training on the RL Breakout MinAtar environment with configurable seed
run_main_function: run the main training loop that trains multiple PPO agents and saves checkpoints to disk
run_cli_training: run the training script from the command line with a custom config YAML file path
review_main_function: review the main function that orchestrates PPO training across multiple random seeds and saves results
summarize_train_module: summarize the train module that loads config, initializes models, runs PPO training, and stores checkpoints
